name: Level 2 Triangle-Voxel Classification
definition: Refines triangle classification into a finer 3D voxel grid (Level 2) using precomputed Level 1 voxel mappings and triangle lists.
summary: Level 2 Triangle-Voxel Classification refines Level 1 results by using ray casting to determine precise inside-outside status for sub-voxels, resolving topology where Level 1 only mapped vertices.
